newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-mo money claims yield rises to 1.649 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-mo money claims yield rises to 1.649 pct.

text.p: The average annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims was 1.649 percent, up from the previous issue's 1.521 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The series 3.378 claims raised 1,146.35 million Swiss francs and were priced at 99.585 percent. Pay date is March 20.
The previous issue of three-month claims, paid for on March 6, raised 805.8 million francs and was priced at 99.617 percent.
